question: Symphysis-fundal height (SFH) measurement should be performed before asking the patient to empty her bladder, so that the baseline uterine volume is captured accurately.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct. SFH must always be measured after the patient empties her bladder. A distended bladder pushes the uterus upward and produces a falsely elevated SFH — a common OSCE error.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is incorrect. A full bladder displaces the uterus superiorly, artificially elevating the fundal height measurement and leading to overestimation of gestational age.
